faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Supreme Court of India Assistant Registrar (Computer) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Supreme Court of India Assistant Registrar (Computer) recruitment is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Registrar (Computer) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Applications or B.E. in Computers or IT or B.Tech. in Computers from a recognized University or equivalent, along with a minimum of 5 years of experience holding analogous posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this recruitment is 56 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Registrar (Computer) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 78,800/- per month (Level-12).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Registrar (Computer) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Registrar (Computer) post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Registrar (Computer) post?
faq.answer: The selection process will include a Computer Test and an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Supreme Court of India located?
faq.answer: The Supreme Court of India is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110001.
